message: cannot adopt the root CRL in the CA certificates ConfigMap; gateways get the root CRL kept, if any (services/certs/README.md, 「根 CRL」)

fields.problem: /etc/trustiot/certs-ca/root-crl.pem: its CRL number 1 is lower than that of root CRL 2 adopted under the same root, so it is older and lacks revocations
